card.name: Linking words in treatment-continuation clauses
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as beyond, if, the, or a closing parenthesis that start a condition or qualifier after a treatment duration or dose statement. Seen in antidepressant and dosing text.

modes.label: Beyond after treatment length
modes.description: The word beyond after a statement of how long treatment should last.
modes.example: require several months or longer of antidepressant treatment<< beyond>> the response in the acute episode.

modes.label: If after dose increase
modes.description: The word if or If starting a condition about raising the dose or about improvement.
modes.example: Consider a dose increase after several weeks<< if>> insufficient clinical improvement is observed.

modes.label: Numbered criteria
modes.description: A closing parenthesis in a numbered list of conditions.
modes.example: (1) is known to respond to antipsychotic drugs, and (2<<)>> for whom alternative, equally effective, but
